text:
emily: Quick check-in: we're T-48h from the marketplace go-live. Need owners for partner press quote, landing page QA, and SI onboarding window. Short replies only pls.

raj: I can take landing page QA — will run visual diff and link checks.

nina: I'll own SI onboarding window + tenant provisioning checklist. Scheduling 1h block starting at go-live +2h for handoffs.

mike-partner: Partner side: I'll provide final customer quote and updated logo asset by EOD today. Also confirm our CSM will join the +2h onboarding.

emily: Press embargo time we set to 2026-04-10T15:00Z. Nina, ensure the onboarding window aligns with partner's support.

press-bot: Embargo confirmed 2026-04-10T15:00Z. Reminders at T-24h and T-1h scheduled.

ops-bot: Quick ops note: staging -> prod cutover will toggle feature-flag marketplace_public. Rollback window = 30m. Alert if provisioning failure >3% within 10m.

raj: Found two broken links on staging hero (privacy policy, partner docs). Pushed fix to staging. Will re-run check at 07:00 PT.

nina: Provisioning runbook updated: added step to validate webhook retries and rate limits. Uploaded to partner portal: /partners/mike-corp/runbooks/onboard-v1.pdf

emily: Contingency: if SI webhook fails, we publish with "Request demo" CTA and a note "Integration pending". Raj, can you prepare that fallback banner?

raj: Yep, I'll add fallback banner and QA variations for mobile.

emily: Owners recap: Raj=page QA & fallback; Nina=SI onboarding & runbook; Mike=partner quote + CSM; Emily=press + embargo. React with :white_check_mark: when done.

mike-partner: :white_check_mark: quote + logo uploaded. CSM confirmed.

raj: :white_check_mark: fixes pushed. Mobile variations ready.

nina: :white_check_mark: runbook uploaded and onboarding slot confirmed.

emily: Thanks team — I'll post an executive summary to the partner channel and meet at the dry-run tomorrow 09:00 PT. If anything blocks, DM me.
